title: Error Function
subtitle: Special Functions · Probability
summary: Integral of the Gaussian. Used in probability and heat transfer.
detail:
\[ \operatorname{erf}(x) = \frac{2}{\sqrt{\pi}}\int_0^x e^{-t^2}\,dt \]

Odd function: \(\operatorname{erf}(-x)=-\operatorname{erf}(x)\). \(\operatorname{erf}(\infty)=1\). The complementary error function \(\operatorname{erfc}(x)=1-\operatorname{erf}(x)\). The normal CDF is \(\Phi(x)=\frac{1}{2}\left[1+\operatorname{erf}\!\left(x/\sqrt{2}\right)\right]\).
